_why: The rights record for the Whisper Almanac teaching lanes (Neville Goddard, Florence Scovel Shinn). Her rulings 9 Nov 2026: quote ONLY from books whose US copyright is gone (Neville: published 1923-1963 and never renewed; Shinn: published before 1930), recorded here per title with the source and the date; a title with a renewal found, or unchecked, is never quoted (its technique is paraphrased in our own words). Never his recorded lectures, his voice, or lecture transcripts. Credit by name; never imply endorsement by any estate or organisation.

Read by loop/teachings.py (the script check: a quote must name a cleared title and match a quote below word for word) and loop/tools/teacher_texts.py (re-downloads the texts, re-verifies every quote, rebuilds config/teacher_shingles.txt for the straight-reading check).

renewal_check.method: Every renewal row 1950-2001 in the NYPL transcription of the Catalog of Copyright Entries renewals (1950-1977) and the US Copyright Office's online renewal records (1978-2001) was searched for 'Goddard' (any field), an author or claimant 'Neville', and each title below. Zero rows for Neville Goddard or any of his titles (the only 'Freedom for all' row is Pearl S. Buck's 1942 magazine piece). A book published 1923-1963 had to be renewed in its 28th year (1939 -> 1966/67 ... 1961 -> 1988/89), all inside the searched files. The Stanford Copyright Renewal Database (the same two sources) refused automated reading on 9 Nov 2026 (a JavaScript challenge); its source data was searched directly instead.
